title: test: the stage-8 test half — suites stop depending on the four catalog row objects (#15204 stage 8, S8-T)
body:
Clause-②: no

Part of #15204 (C3 stage 8, the test half: S8-T). The code half (S8, branch `claude/issue-15204-s8-catalog-objects`) opens after #22900 (D) is on `main`; this PR lands after D and just before S8. #15204 remains open.

## What this changes

Test files only. Every edit keeps the suite green on today's `main` **and** on `main` + D + S8, where the four security-catalog row objects (`sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_position_permission_set`, `sys_capability`) are no longer registered (ADR-0131 D3).

- **A testkit for the retired tables.** `plugin-security/src/__tests__/legacy-catalog-objects.testkit.ts` holds the four tables' shapes (fields, indexes, validations only), for suites that model an existing database whose rows outlive the object declarations until the organization-ownership migration (ADR-0131 D10). 42 suites point their imports at it instead of `./objects/sys-*.object.js`. `withLegacyCatalogTables()` adds the shapes a plugin no longer declares.
- **Deleted, because they pin what S8 removes:** the object-declaration pins (`sys-*.organization-unique`, `sys-capability-deactivation-claim`, `clone-carryover`, the junction/position cases of `rbac-objects`, `reserved-identity-names`, `managed-by-system-data`, `sys-security-assignment-display-title`, `rbac-objects-bulk-exposure`), `position-write-through.test.ts` (S8 unwires that middleware; 7b deletes the module), `bootstrap-platform-admin-refused-existence-read.test.ts` (the legacy-row read S8 removes), `row-active.test.ts` (S8 deletes `isRowActive`), pin 6 of `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts` (the retired object's clone action), and the dogfood files for the data-door write-throughs, the projection, the row lock and the junction gates: `two-doors-permission`, `declared-position-provenance`, `permission-set-lock-row-provenance`, `permission-set-write-through-package-binding`, `showcase-permission-projection`, `position-environment-write-through`, `position-held-name-setup-create`.
- **Fixtures moved off the rows:** dogfood suites that authored a permission set through `POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set` now use `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/:name` (or `protocol.saveMetaItem`); checks that a set "was seeded" read the engine registry; vestigial `sys_position` row inserts are gone; censuses of a retired table answer "no rows" when the object is not registered.
- **Pins made to span the change:** the clone-route refusal prose (`POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set` → the catalog's clone door) is pinned around the route; the uninstall-cleanup runner request may carry `declared`; page/registry floors drop by the retired page and the four names; the tenancy-inventory and dangling-reference fixtures use surviving security tables; `cleanup-package-permissions.test.ts` passes the package's declared set names and asserts what holds both ways (grants naming the sets revoked, suggestion rows removed).
- **New pins:**
  - `bootstrap-platform-admin-fresh-boot.golden.test.ts` — a fresh `single`-posture engine holding only the plugin's own objects promotes its first human (E6's first pin). Ablation on the integration tree: with D's `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` (the legacy-row read) put back, both cases go red (`adminPromoted: false`); restored, green; `git diff HEAD` empty after restore. E6's second pin (an unnamed legacy admin grant mints no second administrator) is the existing `grant-readers-unnamed-grant.test.ts` case, green on both sides.
  - `permission-metadata-door-reaches-catalog.dogfood.test.ts` — a create, an edit and a delete through `/api/v1/meta/permission` each reach the security catalog the resolver reads, and a grant naming the set is accepted exactly while the catalog holds it. Green on `main` (projector wired) and on `main` + D + S8 (projector unwired): the premise E1 → A rested on.

## After D lands

D rewrites several of the same files, so this branch takes a `main` merge before it lands. The resolutions were made and run on a local integration tree (`main` + D + this PR + S8): take this PR's deletions over D's edits; in `activity-text-predicate`, `approval-snapshot-masked-field`, `sharing-rule-org-less-caller` and `showcase-crud-persona-matrix` keep D's `catalogPermissionSet` reads; in `showcase-fls-read-mask-strip` and `showcase-permission-zoo` take this PR's side; delete `ensureLegacyPermissionSetRow` from D's `catalog-permission-set.ts` (no caller left); guard the row census in D's `showcase-permission-seeding` with `getObject('sys_permission_set')`.

## Verification

- On `main` (`eab7236ff7`), this branch alone: every touched or added test file, 71 files in 11 packages, green (plugin-security 44 files / 752 tests, dogfood 13 / 146, metadata-protocol 3 / 89, objectql 2 / 58, cli unit 2 / 35, others 1 file each). Typecheck of the touched packages green.
- On `main` + D (`fcaedfdaa1`) + this PR + S8: plugin-security full suite, the dogfood suite in full, and the suites of core, spec, lint, metadata-protocol, cloud-connection, objectql, plugin-sharing, platform-objects, service-settings, plugin-auth, rest, runtime, verify, organizations, plugin-approvals, plugin-hono-server, client, example-showcase, example-crm and cli (unit) — see the report on #15204 for the numbers.
- Size: 88 files, +1,122 / −3,946 = 5,068 changed lines — over the 3,000 line, almost all deletion; see the report on #15204.

`skip-changeset`: only test files, a test-only testkit under `src/__tests__` (no entry imports it; `files` ships `dist` only) and the private dogfood package change.
